Offer a spare room. Change someone's year.

Hosts provide a private bedroom for short, supported stays of 2–8 weeks. You set the house rules and a few fair chores, and you're never alone: support workers, a safeguarding team and a fair issue process back you up.
All hosts are identity-checked and a Working with Children Check or equivalent is required where the program rules say so.

This agreement sets out the hosting conditions: a private bedroom for the agreed period; the proposed A$100 per eligible verified week subsidy paid only for verified occupancy under the program's rules, with a maximum duration per stay; the fair issue-resolution process; double-blind feedback; privacy obligations; and the program's right to pause or end hosting where conditions aren't met. It is a demo text, not a legal document.

How the subsidy is calculated (program policy, configurable by the administrator)
• Counted from a host-confirmed check-in to a confirmed checkout. Unverified bookings earn nothing.
weeks per stay. Stays beyond the maximum earn no further subsidy; extensions need program approval.
• Paused or cancelled stays stop accruing from the pause date. Adjustments show the reason.

• Steady’s own revenue (A$30 of each weekly A$50 program contribution, plus memberships) is separate and never part of your subsidy. The other A$20 a week is credited to your guest’s own savings. Subsidy payments are government expenditure and need program approval plus verified occupancy.
